title: RIPPLE: Recovery Internalization through Process-Level Policy Learning and Effect-Aware Credit for Long-Horizon Agentic Coding
abstract: arXiv:2610.31276v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Long-horizon coding agents can observe a failure and generate a plausible critique yet continue along the same incorrect trajectory. We call this the Critique-to-Action Handoff Gap. We introduce RIPPLE, a recovery-oriented training framework that internalizes process-level guidance into a single self-recovering policy. A prefix-only teacher provides evidence-grounded recovery supervision without access to future actions or terminal outcomes. After lightweight distillation, reinforcement learning assigns stage-specific credit to reflection triggering, diagnosis, and corrective action. Local validity signals gate trajectory advantages so that intermediate recovery decisions do not indiscriminately inherit terminal outcomes. Across four repository-level software-engineering benchmarks, RIPPLE improves the base policy by an arithmetic mean of 4.8 score points, with no auxiliary critic at deployment. translated_title: RIPPLE：面向长程智能体编程的过程级策略学习与效果感知信用分配的恢复内化
translated_abstract: 长程编程智能体能够观察到失败并生成看似合理的批评，却仍沿着同一条错误轨迹继续运行。我们将这一现象称为“批评到行动交接鸿沟”。我们提出RIPPLE，一个面向恢复的训练框架，将过程级指导内化到单一的自恢复策略中。一个仅使用前缀的教师模型在不访问未来动作或最终结果的情况下提供基于证据的恢复监督。在轻量级蒸馏之后，强化学习对反思触发、诊断和纠正行动分配阶段特定的信用。局部有效性信号对轨迹优势进行门控，使中间恢复决策不会不加区分地继承最终结果。在四个仓库级软件工程基准上，RIPPLE将基础策略平均提升4.8个分数点，且部署时无需辅助评论家。受控消融实验分离出各组成部分的收益。
tldr: 提出RIPPLE训练框架，通过前缀教师蒸馏与阶段特定的强化学习信用分配，将过程级恢复能力内化到单一自恢复策略中，弥合编程智能体“能批评却无法行动”的交接鸿沟，并在仓库级软件工程基准上平均提升4.8分。
en_tdlr: RIPPLE is a recovery-oriented training framework that internalizes process-level recovery guidance into a single self-recovering policy via prefix-only teacher distillation and stage-specific reinforcement learning credit assignment, bridging the Critique-to-Action Handoff Gap and improving base policies by an average of 4.8 points on repository-level software engineering benchmarks.
